title: Brightline: plain tools for small teams

sections.title: Plan the week in ten minutes
sections.dek: Brightline turns a pile of requests into a plan your whole team can read on a phone.

sections.heading: Everything a small team needs, nothing it does not
sections.intro: One shared plan, one inbox for requests, and a weekly review that fits in a meeting.

items.title: One shared plan
items.text: Everyone sees the same list, in the same order, on any screen.

items.title: A single inbox
items.text: Requests land in one place and are triaged once, not five times.

items.title: Weekly review
items.text: A ten-minute summary of what moved, what stalled, and what is next.

items.title: Works offline
items.text: Open it on a train. Changes sync when the signal returns.
